videos.title: YOLOv8 Object Detection with Flask | Object Detection Web Application
videos.description: Learn how to build a real-time AI-based Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) Detection System for construction sites using YOLOv8 and Flask. This project allows you to detect safety helmets, vests, and other PPE in live video feeds or images, ensuring workplace safety and compliance.  In this step-by-step tutorial, you will learn: How to set up YOLOv8 for custom object detection. Creating a Flask web application to run your AI model. Real-time detection and visualization of PPE on construction workers. How to handle challenging conditions like different angles, lighting, and occlusions. videos.title: The Flan Collection: Open Source Instruction Tuning | Paper explained
videos.description: If you are looking to add advanced expertise in Natural Language Processing to your team, you should check out our services at The Global NLP Lab: https://nlplab.tech/.  This video was created with Synthesia: https://www.synthesia.io/?via=nlplab  Papers to read:   - Scaling Instruction-Finetuned Language Models (https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.11416)  - The Flan Collection: Designing Data and Methods for Effective Instruction Tuning (https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.13688)  Blog post: https://ai.googleblog.com/2023/02/the-flan-collection-advancing-open.html  Abstract: We study the design decisions of publicly available instruction tuning methods, and break down the development of Flan 2022 (Chung et al., 2022). Through careful ablation studies on the Flan Collection of tasks and methods, we tease apart the effect of design decisions which enable Flan-T5 to outperform prior work by 3-17%+ across evaluation settings. We find task balancing and enrichment techniques are overlooked but critical to effective instruction tuning, and in particular, training with mixed prompt settings (zero-shot, few-shot, and chain-of-thought) actually yields stronger (2%+) performance in all settings. In further experiments, we show Flan-T5 requires less finetuning to converge higher and faster than T5 on single downstream tasks, motivating instruction-tuned models as more computationally-efficient starting checkpoints for new tasks. Finally, to accelerate research on instruction tuning, we make the Flan 2022 collection of datasets, templates, and methods publicly available at this https URL.
